versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The code configuration of the Eth module is Ethernet controller specific. If the Ethernet controller is sited on-chip, the code generation tool for the Eth module is microcontroller specific. If the Ethernet controller is an external device (i.e. MACPHY), the generation tool must not be microcontroller specific.
